verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships its own AI features over the user's scan data. Semgrep Assistant does AI post-processing of findings to cut noise, AI-Powered Detection finds business-logic flaws, and the homepage claims AI reasoning for detection, triage, and remediation. The evidence is only brief marketing and README lines, with no documentation of what insights or suggestions users actually see or how they work. The community LLM-over-SARIF tool is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: in-depth docs on Assistant's in-product triage insights and remediation suggestions, how and where suggestions are surfaced, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Contextual post-processing of findings with Semgrep Assistant (AI) to further reduce noise by ~20%
Combine AI reasoning with rule-based analysis for detection, triage, and remediation
With AI-Powered Detection, you can automatically identify complex business logic flaws, such as IDORs and broken authorization.
